meta.topic: Who You Are When No One's Looking

headline: Character is what you do in the dark
universal_truth: Your private self is your truest self
fun_facts: Philosopher John Stuart Mill said the worth of a state is the worth of the individuals composing it
Research shows that people behave more ethically when they feel observed—a phenomenon called the 'audience effect'
Ancient Greek philosophers believed that character (ethos) was the foundation of a good life, more important than reputation
discussion_questions: How different are you when no one is watching?
What private behaviors are you most proud of?
What would you change if you lived as though everything were visible?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Who are you when no one is watching? This question cuts deeper than reputation or performance. It asks about character—the you that exists in private. Today we explore why your hidden self might be your most important self.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Most of us have a public persona and a private reality. We curate what others see. But here's the question worth asking: which version is the real you?
cliff.prompt: Which version of yourself is most 'real'?

options.response: Yes. Without audience pressure, what remains is your actual character—for better or worse.
The public version shows who you want to be. But character is about who you already are, not just who you perform.

q1.title: The Audience Effect
q1.script: Studies confirm what you suspect: people behave better when observed. We're more generous, more honest, more careful when there's an audience. This isn't hypocrisy—it's human. But it means our private behavior reveals something truer about our current character.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "The Audience Effect"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Character as Habit
q2.script: Aristotle taught that character is shaped by repeated action. Who you are isn't some fixed essence—it's the accumulation of countless small choices. Every private moment is practice. You become what you repeatedly do, especially when no one's counting.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Integrity
q3.script: Integrity literally means wholeness—the same inside and outside. It doesn't mean perfection. It means the gap between your public and private self gets smaller. The goal isn't to eliminate the private self, but to make it one you're proud of.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Your private moments are not breaks from real life—they are real life. Who you choose to be when no one's watching is who you're actually becoming. Make those moments count.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's today's lesson on character and integrity. Tomorrow, we'll explore what you leave behind. Until then, be someone you'd admire—even in private.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Integrity Check - Private Alignment
growTrack.learning_objective: Increase alignment between public persona and private behavior
growTrack.activity: Pick one small private behavior you'd be proud of if it were public—and do it consistently this week. It could be how you talk to yourself, what you consume online, or how you handle frustration alone.
